in_sanskrit.name: Ilesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Rain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ilesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ilesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ila' meaning rain and 'Sh' meaning god. Ilesh is the name of a Hindu deity associated with the rain god Indra. He is believed to bring prosperity and abundance.
